from solution import remove_splchar


def test_issue_example():
    """Remove everything except alphanumeric characters from a string."""
    # "python" + "program" + "123" = "pythonprogram123"
    assert remove_splchar('python  @#&^%$*program123') == 'pythonprogram123'


def test_issue_empty_string():
    """Remove everything except alphanumeric characters from a string."""
    # "" filtered = ""
    assert remove_splchar('') == ''


def test_issue_alphanumeric_unchanged():
    """Remove everything except alphanumeric characters from a string."""
    # "abc" + "XYZ" + "123" = "abcXYZ123"
    assert remove_splchar('abcXYZ123') == 'abcXYZ123'


def test_issue_only_special_chars():
    """Remove everything except alphanumeric characters from a string."""
    # "!@#" + " " + "$%^&*()" = "" (0 kept)
    assert remove_splchar('!@# $%^&*()') == ''


def test_issue_spaces_removed():
    """Remove everything except alphanumeric characters from a string."""
    # "a" + "b" + "c" = "abc"
    assert remove_splchar('a b c') == 'abc'


def test_issue_underscore_removed():
    """Remove everything except alphanumeric characters from a string."""
    # "hello" + "world" = "helloworld"
    assert remove_splchar('hello_world') == 'helloworld'


def test_issue_digits_preserved():
    """Remove everything except alphanumeric characters from a string."""
    # "a" + "1" + "b" + "2" + "c" + "3" = "a1b2c3"
    assert remove_splchar('a1!b2@c3#') == 'a1b2c3'


def test_issue_sentence_punctuation():
    """Remove everything except alphanumeric characters from a string."""
    # "Hello" + "World" + "2024" = "HelloWorld2024"
    assert remove_splchar('Hello, World! 2024?') == 'HelloWorld2024'


def test_issue_tab_newline_removed():
    """Remove everything except alphanumeric characters from a string."""
    # "a" + "b" + "c" = "abc"
    assert remove_splchar('a\tb\nc') == 'abc'


def test_contract_case_preserved():
    """Remove everything except alphanumeric characters from a string."""
    # "Ab" + "C" + "xY" = "AbCxY"
    assert remove_splchar('Ab-C_xY!') == 'AbCxY'


def test_contract_returns_str():
    """Remove everything except alphanumeric characters from a string."""
    # "a" + "b" + "1" = "ab1" and type is str
    result = remove_splchar('a!b@1#')
    assert result == 'ab1'
